transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
Since I started this job and the tech program at the same time, I feel like I’m not handling the pressure well and it’s messing up my school and work. It's just all becoming a bit too much to manage.

Did these feelings start mainly after beginning the new job and tech program, or were you already feeling this way before? If the stress from those changes were removed, do you think your symptoms would mostly go away?

Yeah, they definitely started right after I began the job, the program, and moved into my own place—before that, I was actually doing fine and felt excited. I really think that once I get used to the schedule and things settle into a routine, this overwhelmed feeling will ease up and I'll be able to handle things normally again.

How much has this stress been affecting your daily functioning—like your work performance, schoolwork, sleep, or relationships? Have you had to miss classes or work, or have you fallen behind because of it?

It's having a huge impact—I've already missed several evening classes and had to swap a few work shifts last-minute because I'm so overwhelmed. Instead of going to class or my maker meetup, I just sit in my apartment scrolling on my phone to avoid everything. Both my advisor and supervisor have warned me that my spot in the program and my job are at risk if this keeps up.

Along with feeling overwhelmed by these recent changes, have you also had persistent depression or loss of interest, or frequent panic attacks or constant excessive worry that feels out of proportion? Or does it mainly feel tied to the stress of the new job, school, and move?

It definitely feels directly tied to the stress of this massive transition with the new job, school, and move, rather than constant depression or panic attacks. I've stopped doing my usual hobbies like basketball, painting, and hiking because I'm constantly on edge and overwhelmed by it all. I really hope that once I get adjusted to this new schedule and routine, these feelings will start to ease up.
About how long has it been since these symptoms started after the job, school, and move? Has it been less than 6 months so far?

It’s been going on for about a month now, starting just a few weeks after I moved and began the job and classes. So yeah, it has definitely been less than six months. I'm really hoping that once I get used to the routine, this feeling will start to lift.
